The '''''Gauntlet''''' was a [[Kom'rk-class fighter/transport|''Kom'rk''-class fighter/transport]] that was used by [[Bo-Katan Kryze]], leader of the [[Mandalorian]] [[Nite Owls]], during her search for allies who would help liberate her people's [[homeworld]], [[Mandalore]]. Accompanied by two other Nite Owls, Kryze used the ship when pursuing [[Ahsoka Tano]], a former [[Jedi]], from the [[planet]] [[Oba Diah]] to [[Level 1313]] on [[Coruscant]].

==Description==
[[File:BoKatanKryze-SWZ91.png|thumb|left|300px|The ''Gauntlet'' flies through an atmosphere]]
As a [[Kom'rk-class fighter/transport|''Kom'rk''-class fighter/transport]], the ''Gauntlet''<ref name="X-Wing">{{Twitter|atomicmassgames|status/1471873135582580744|[[Atomic Mass Games]]|archivedate=20211217203334}}</ref> was equipped with a Class 1 [[hyperdrive]],<ref name="Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles" /> four [[engine]]s, a [[targeting computer]], and four [[laser cannon]]s; two mounted on its nose, and two on the rear. The [[starship]] could be crewed by two [[pilot]]s,<ref name="Together Again" /> and measured 52.3 [[meter]]s in length. Like other ships in its class, it could reach a top speed of 1,000 [[Kilometer per hour|kph]].<ref name="Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles" />

==History==
{{Quote|I need your help. Once we are underway I will explain everything.|Kryze asks Ahsoka Tano to join the Nite Owls aboard the ''Kom'rk''-class fighter/transport|audio=INeedYourHelp-TA.flac|<ref name="Together Again" />}}
In [[19 BBY]],<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> following the [[Takeover of Mandalore|dissolution]] of the [[Mandalorian]] splinter group, [[Death Watch]], the [[homeworld]] of the Mandalorians, [[Mandalore]], fell under the rule of the [[Dathomirian]] renegade [[Sith Lord]] [[Maul]]. Consequently, [[Bo-Katan Kryze]], leader of the [[Nite Owls]] and a former member of the Death Watch, took refuge aboard the ''Gauntlet'' alongside [[Ursa Wren]] and another Nite Owl. As the leader of the [[Mandalore resistance]], Kryze and the others searched for potential allies to join them and help liberate their home from Maul's control.<ref name="Gauntlet-DB">{{Databank|the-gauntlet|Mandalorian Gauntlet starfighter}}</ref>

[[File:Gauntlet-1313-TG.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The ship at Level 1313]]
That same [[Standard year|year]],<ref name="Timelines" /> during the trio's pursuit of former [[Jedi]] [[Ahsoka Tano]], Kryze piloted the ''Kom'rk''-class [[Starfighter|fighter]] and departed<ref name="Together Again" /> the [[planet]]<ref name="Oba Diah">{{Databank|oba-diah|Oba Diah}}</ref> [[Oba Diah]], tailing the<ref name="Together Again" /> [[Nebula-class freighter|''Nebula''-class freighter]] ''[[Silver Angel]]'',<ref name="SilverAngel-DB">{{Databank|the-silver-angel|The ''Silver Angel''}}</ref> a ship that Tano was traveling aboard. Locking on the ''Angel'' using the fighter's targeting [[computer]], they followed the [[freighter]] to [[Level 1313]] on<ref name="Together Again" /> the [[Core Worlds]] planet<ref name="UltimateSW">''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]''</ref> [[Coruscant]], where Kryze met Tano and requested her assistance. When the former Jedi agreed to help the Nite Owl, they boarded the ''Kom'rk''-class fighter/transport and departed Level 1313 together.<ref name="Together Again" />

During the [[New Republic Era]], [[Bo-Katan Kryze]] utilized her Gauntlet starfighter to travel. At one point, the ship was present on [[Lafete]].<ref name="The Rescue">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 16: The Rescue}}</ref> She later used her starfighter to travel from [[Kalevala]] to [[Mandalore]] with [[R5-D4]] and [[Din Grogu|Grogu]].<ref name="Chapter 18">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 18: The Mines of Mandalore}}</ref> When she had returned to Kalevala, she was [[Bombing of Kryze Castle|attacked]] by [[TIE/IN interceptor]]s. She was able to destroy several interceptors, and utilized a [[heat-seeking missile]] to destroy a [[TIE/sa tactical bomber|TIE/sa bomber]], but eventually retreated after a backup of TIEs arrived.<ref name="Chapter 19">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 19: The Convert}}</ref>

==Owners and operators==
Following Maul's takeover of Mandalore, Kryze took refuge aboard the ''Gauntlet'' alongside Ursa Wren and another Nite Owl during their search for allies willing to help them liberate Mandalore.<ref name="Gauntlet-DB" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Gauntlet-ConceptArt.jpg|thumb|right|220px|''Kom'rk''-class fighter/transport concept art by JP Balmet]]
The ''Gauntlet'' first appeared in "[[Together Again]],"<ref name="Together Again" /> the eighth episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season Seven|seventh]] and final season of the television series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'', which aired on [[April 10]], [[2020]].<ref name="Disney Press Release">{{DisneyPlus|subdomain=press|url=disney-plus/star-wars-the-clone-wars/708|text=Episode 708 "Together Again"}}</ref> Concept art for the ship's interiors, dated to [[June 7]], [[2018]], was drawn by [[JP Balmet]], while the lighting concept was done by [[Jason Boesch]].<ref name="Together Again-ConceptArt">{{SW|url=together-again-concept-art-gallery|text="Together Again" Concept Art Gallery}} {{C|Slides 3 and 12}}</ref> The ship received its name in the<ref name="X-Wing" /> [[2022]]<ref name="Asmodee">{{Asmodee|subdomain=shop|url=star-wars-x-wing-2nd-ed-5-gauntlet-fighter-swz91|text=Star Wars X-Wing 2nd Ed: Gauntlet Fighter}}</ref> ''[[Gauntlet Fighter Expansion Pack]]'' for the ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Second Edition]]'' miniature game,<ref name="X-Wing" /> released by [[Atomic Mass Games]].<ref name="Asmodee" />
